headline: Almost brought Speed to Tears Speed thought a young fan was about to ask him for a friend
body: Almost brought Speed to Tears Speed thought a young fan was about to ask him for a friend request, but the kid just wanted to tell him he’s a good guy, wish him a great day, and remind him that God loves him The sweetest part was how simple it was. The kid had a chance to talk to one of his favorite streamers, and he used it to make sure Speed heard something kind. He said what he came to say without asking for a single thing in return.

source_caption_text:
Almost brought Speed to Tears 🥹❤️❤️

Speed thought a young fan was about to ask him for a friend request, but the kid just wanted to tell him he’s a good guy, wish him a great day, and remind him that God loves him 🥹❤️

The sweetest part was how simple it was. The kid had a chance to talk to one of his favorite streamers, and he used it to make sure Speed heard something kind. He said what he came to say without asking for a single thing in return.

Sometimes a few words from someone you’ve never met can make your whole day. Hope that kid had a great day too ❤️
